name: near-sdk-as
description: A small AssemblyScript SDK for NEAR contracts

scripts.build: npm run build:hello && npm run build:counters && npm run build:collections && npm run build:guest-book && npm run build:donation && npm run build:coin-flip && npm run build:cross-contract-simple && npm run build:cross-contract-advanced && npm run build:factory && npm run build:nft && npm run build:basic-auction
scripts.build:hello: node bin/near-as.mjs build examples/hello-near/contract.ts --out examples/hello-near/build/contract.wasm --sdk src/index.ts
scripts.build:counters: node bin/near-as.mjs build examples/counters/contract.ts --out examples/counters/build/contract.wasm --sdk src/index.ts
scripts.build:collections: node bin/near-as.mjs build examples/collections/contract.ts --out examples/collections/build/contract.wasm --sdk src/index.ts
scripts.build:guest-book: node bin/near-as.mjs build examples/guest-book/contract.ts --out examples/guest-book/build/contract.wasm --sdk src/index.ts
scripts.build:donation: node bin/near-as.mjs build examples/donation/contract.ts --out examples/donation/build/contract.wasm --sdk src/index.ts
scripts.build:coin-flip: node bin/near-as.mjs build examples/coin-flip/contract.ts --out examples/coin-flip/build/contract.wasm --sdk src/index.ts
scripts.build:cross-contract-simple: node bin/near-as.mjs build examples/cross-contract-simple/test-contracts/hello-near/contract.ts --out examples/cross-contract-simple/test-contracts/hello-near/build/contract.wasm --sdk src/index.ts && node bin/near-as.mjs build examples/cross-contract-simple/contract.ts --out examples/cross-contract-simple/build/contract.wasm --sdk src/index.ts
scripts.build:cross-contract-advanced: node bin/near-as.mjs build examples/cross-contract-advanced/test-contracts/hello-near/contract.ts --out examples/cross-contract-advanced/test-contracts/hello-near/build/contract.wasm --sdk src/index.ts && node bin/near-as.mjs build examples/cross-contract-advanced/test-contracts/counters/contract.ts --out examples/cross-contract-advanced/test-contracts/counters/build/contract.wasm --sdk src/index.ts && node bin/near-as.mjs build examples/cross-contract-advanced/test-contracts/guest-book/contract.ts --out examples/cross-contract-advanced/test-contracts/guest-book/build/contract.wasm --sdk src/index.ts && node bin/near-as.mjs build examples/cross-contract-advanced/contract.ts --out examples/cross-contract-advanced/build/contract.wasm --sdk src/index.ts
scripts.build:factory: npm run build:factory-token && node bin/near-as.mjs build examples/factory/contract.ts --out examples/factory/build/contract.wasm --sdk src/index.ts
scripts.build:nft: node bin/near-as.mjs build examples/nft/test-contracts/token-receiver/contract.ts --out examples/nft/test-contracts/token-receiver/build/contract.wasm --sdk src/index.ts && node bin/near-as.mjs build examples/nft/src/lib.ts --out examples/nft/build/contract.wasm --sdk src/index.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:compiler && npm run test:contract && npm run test:sandbox
